Global keywords: inherit, initial,
unset, revert

Global keywords provide explicit control over inherited values, initial values and lower cascade
origins.

කරනවා. revert current cascade origin එJකේ styles වලින් පෙසුපෙසට යනවා.
Reset a component’s inherited text color or spacing.
Parent color: green · color: inherit →green Child: margin: initial · margin: 0 (initial)

Read the diagram: 1. Inherit reads parent. 2. Initial reads property default, not necessarily browser
stylesheet. 3. Unset selects based on natural inheritance.
Color inherit කිරීJමන් parent green value එක ලුJබනවා. Initial margin value එක 0 Jවනවා.

Expected result: Paragraph inherits green; margin initial is zero. Button inherits parent font
settings.
Interview question: What is the difference between initial and inherit?
Answer: Initial uses the specification’s initial value; inherit uses the parent computed value.
Remember: Initial = property default; inherit = parent.
Practice: Try unset on color and margin.
